title: TaxBreak: Unmasking the Hidden Costs of LLM Inference Through Overhead Decomposition
authors: Prabhu Vellaisamy; Shreesh Tripathi; Vignesh Natarajan; Surya Santhan Thenarasu; Shawn Blanton; John P. Shen
research_focus: LLM serving, MoE serving, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design

problem_statement.en: In latency-sensitive LLM deployments, inference time can become dominated by host-side orchestration overhead, but existing approaches expose this cost only as an aggregate residual (framework tax) or a launch/queue metric (TKLQT), which is insufficient to identify which execution layer (Python dispatch, CUDA library front-end, or kernel launch path) should be optimized.
problem_statement.zh: 在延遲敏感的 LLM 部署中，inference time 可能被 host 端 orchestration overhead 主導，但既有做法僅以聚合殘差（framework tax）或 launch/queue metric（TKLQT）呈現此成本，難以辨識應該優化哪一層執行路徑（Python dispatch、CUDA library front-end 或 kernel launch path）。

key_innovation.en: TaxBreak is a trace-driven methodology that decomposes host-visible orchestration overhead into three mutually exclusive components per kernel invocation: framework translation (ΔFT), CUDA library translation (ΔCT), and kernel launch path (ΔKT), with a per-kernel launch floor T_sys^floor characterized via null-kernel nsys profiling. It further defines the Host-Device Balance Index HDBI = T_DeviceActive / (T_DeviceActive + T_Orchestration) as a diagnostic for whether optimization effort should target the software stack or the device side.
key_innovation.zh: TaxBreak 是一套 trace-driven 方法，將 host 端可見的 orchestration overhead 在每個 kernel invocation 中拆解為三個互斥成分：framework translation (ΔFT)、CUDA library translation (ΔCT) 與 kernel launch path (ΔKT)，並以 null-kernel nsys profiling 量測 per-kernel launch floor T_sys^floor。此外提出 Host-Device Balance Index HDBI = T_DeviceActive / (T_DeviceActive + T_Orchestration) 作為診斷指標，判斷優化應針對 software stack 或 device 端。

baselines_compared: Framework tax, TKLQT, GPU Inference Characterization

key_improvements.en: TaxBreak shows MoE models dispatch 8-11x more GPU kernels per output token than dense models of comparable active parameter count (OLMoE-1B/7B issues 9,305 kernels per token vs. 848 for Llama-3.2-1B). A faster host CPU (Sapphire Rapids vs. Emerald Rapids) reduces T_Orchestration by 10-29% and improves end-to-end latency by 11-14% even when paired with a slower-clocked GPU. FlashAttention-2 on Llama-3.2-1B at BS=8/SL=2048 lowers end-to-end latency by 68.6% and T_Orchestration by 24%.
key_improvements.zh: TaxBreak 顯示 MoE 模型在每個 output token 上 dispatch 的 GPU kernel 數比相當 active parameter 規模的 dense 模型高 8-11 倍（OLMoE-1B/7B 每 token 啟動 9,305 個 kernel，Llama-3.2-1B 僅 848 個）。較快的 host CPU（Sapphire Rapids 對比 Emerald Rapids）可將 T_Orchestration 降低 10-29%，並使 end-to-end latency 改善 11-14%，即使搭配時脈較低的 GPU 亦然。在 Llama-3.2-1B、BS=8/SL=2048 設定下，FlashAttention-2 可將 end-to-end latency 降低 68.6%，T_Orchestration 降低 24%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200 NVL, Intel Xeon 8480C, Intel Xeon Gold 6538Y+, HBM
reported_accuracy: 95% confidence interval of T_Orchestration below 0.34 ms across all configurations

scope_assumptions.en: Single-GPU SLURM allocations only; methodology is evaluated on NVIDIA GPUs and depends on CUDA tracing interfaces (nsys, NVTX, CUPTI); replay-based attribution can be imperfect for highly dynamic, autotuned, or synchronization-heavy kernels; evaluation focuses on eager mode (no torch.compile or CUDA Graphs); HDBI is a diagnostic work ratio rather than an optimization objective and must be interpreted alongside absolute latency.
scope_assumptions.zh: 僅評估單 GPU SLURM 配置；方法在 NVIDIA GPU 上驗證，依賴 CUDA tracing 介面（nsys、NVTX、CUPTI）；對高度動態、autotuned 或 synchronization-heavy 的 kernel，replay-based attribution 可能不精確；評估聚焦於 eager mode（未涵蓋 torch.compile 或 CUDA Graphs）；HDBI 為 diagnostic work ratio 而非優化目標，須與絕對 latency 一併解讀。
